content.text: Come thou and all thy house into the ark, Gen. 7:1. this is none other but the house of God, Gen. 28:17. not a house where there was not one dead, Ex. 12:30. according to the house of their fathers, Num. 34:14. brought thee forth out of … Egypt, from the house of bondage, Deut. 8:14. as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord, Josh. 24:15. iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be purged, 1 Sam. 3:14. have not dwelt in any house since … out of Egypt, 2 Sam. 7:6 (1 Chr. 17:5). Lord … will make thee an house, 2 Sam. 7:11 (1 Chr. 17:10). I purpose to build an house unto the name of the Lord, 1 Kgs. 5:5. house which king Solomon built, 1 Kgs. 6:2 (2 Chr. 3:1). glory … filled the house of the Lord, 1 Kgs. 8:11 (2 Chr. 5:14). this house … is called by thy name, 1 Kgs. 8:43 (2 Chr. 6:33). Set thine house in order, 2 Kgs. 20:1 (Isa. 38:1). found the book of the law in the house, 2 Kgs. 22:8 (2 Chr. 34:15). he burnt the house of the Lord, 2 Kgs. 25:9 (Jer. 52:13). Joash was minded to repair the house of the Lord, 2 Chr. 24:4. sanctify the house of the Lord God, 2 Chr. 29:5. to build him an house in Jerusalem, 2 Chr. 36:23 (Ezra 1:2). I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever, Ps. 23:6 (27:4). I went with them to the house of God, Ps. 42:4. zeal of thine house hath eaten me up, Ps. 69:9 (John 2:17). rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Ps. 84:10. Let us go into the house of the Lord, Ps. 122:1. Her house is the way to hell, Prov. 7:27. troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind, Prov. 11:29. house of the wicked shall be overthrown, Prov. 14:11. Through wisdom is an house builded, Prov. 24:3. mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established, Isa. 2:2 (2 Ne. 12:2). let us go up … to the house of the God, Isa. 2:3 (Micah 4:2; 2 Ne. 12:3). Woe unto them that join house to house, Isa. 5:8. saith the Lord … concerning the house of Jacob, Isa. 29:22. in mine house … give them an everlasting name, Isa. 56:5. mine house shall be called an house of prayer, Isa. 56:7 (Matt. 21:13; Mark 11:17; Luke 19:46). Our holy and our beautiful house … is burned up, Isa. 64:11. where is the house that ye build, Isa. 66:1 (Acts 7:49). house of Judah … house of Israel … shall come together, Jer. 3:18. this house … become a den of robbers, Jer. 7:11. Build ye houses, and dwell in them, Jer. 29:5. they are a rebellious house, Ezek. 2:5. watchman unto the house of Israel, Ezek. 3:17 (33:7). glory of the Lord filled the house, Ezek. 43:5. mountain of the house as the high places of the forest, Micah 3:12. enemies are the men of his own house, Micah 7:6. time that the Lord’s house should be built, Hag. 1:2. returned to Jerusalem … house shall be built, Zech. 1:16. tithes … meat in mine house, Mal. 3:10 (3 Ne. 24:10).

house … fell: and great was the fall, Matt. 7:27 (3 Ne. 14:27). Jesus came into the ruler’s house, Matt. 9:23 (Mark 5:38). entered into the house of God, Matt. 12:4 (Mark 2:26; Luke 6:4). house divided against itself, Matt. 12:25 (Mark 3:25; Luke 11:17). ye devour widows’ houses, Matt. 23:14 (Mark 12:40; Luke 20:47). your house is left unto you desolate, Matt. 23:38 (Luke 13:35). keep the passover at thy house, Matt. 26:18. know not when the master of the house cometh, Mark 13:35. compel them to come in, that my house may be filled, Luke 14:23. sweep the house, and seek diligently, Luke 15:8. is salvation come to this house, Luke 19:9. make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise, John 2:16. himself believed, and his whole house, John 4:53. house was filled with the odour of the ointment, John 12:3. In my Father’s house are many mansions, John 14:2. breaking bread from house to house, Acts 2:46. possessors of lands or houses sold them, Acts 4:34. one that feared God with all his house, Acts 10:2. thou shalt be saved, and thy house, Acts 16:31. believed on the Lord with all his house, Acts 18:8. have taught you publickly, and from house to house, Acts 20:20. church that is in their house, Rom. 16:5 (1 Cor. 16:19). clothed upon with our house which is from heaven, 2 Cor. 5:2. One that ruleth well his own house, 1 Tim. 3:4. oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, 1 Tim. 3:15. this sort are they which creep into houses, 2 Tim. 3:6. who subvert whole houses, Titus 1:11. builded the house hath more honour than the house, Heb. 3:3. Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, Heb. 3:6. prepared an ark to the saving of his house, Heb. 11:7. built up a spiritual house, 1 Pet. 2:5. judgment must begin at the house of God, 1 Pet. 4:17. receive him not into your house, 2 Jn. 1:10.
my people, which are of the house of Israel, 2 Ne. 29:14.

visit the house of each member, D&C 20:47 (20:51). Govern your house in meekness, D&C 31:9. go to the house of prayer … upon my holy day, D&C 59:9. from house to house, D&C 75:18. an house shall be built unto the Lord, D&C 84:5. establish a house, even a house of prayer, D&C 88:119 (109:8). set in order your own house, D&C 93:43. a house … for the salvation of Zion, D&C 97:12. manifest myself … in this house, D&C 110:7. upon my house shall it begin, D&C 112:25. severed from the ordinances of mine house, D&C 121:19. ordained by the ordinance of my holy house, D&C 124:39. flee unto Jerusalem, unto the mountains of the Lord’s house, D&C 133:13.
